title: 第13章 三天之内必取狗皇帝性命第14章 乾坤大挪移
lines: 皇宫里，各种不用的院子非常多。
白羽随便找了一间，然后开始搬运武功秘籍。
在这躺着看岂不是更自在。
院子里，他搭了一个吊床躺在上边，手里拿着一本内功心法。
他现在主攻心法，打算先研究出一本档次高的内功出来先用着。
他现在除了看书之外，就是每天拓宽经脉，不断积蓄内力。
太耽误事儿了，他想研究出来一本自动拓宽经脉，自动运行周天积蓄内力的神功。
看到一句话，白羽忍不住跟着念道：“开发人体潜能？”
他一下坐起身拍了拍脑门道：“嘶～，怎么把这个都忘记了，一定要研究出来。”
每个人体内潜藏的力量本来是非常庞大的，只是平时使不出来，但每逢紧急关头，往往平常一个手无缚鸡之力的弱者能瞬间击打出上千斤的巨力。
只不过，用出来以后人体多半也会损伤严重。
乾坤大挪移，那不正是一门激活人体潜能的武功吗？
他张无忌能装，缺了这门功夫他也装不圆润。
当下，白羽下定决心一定要研究出来。
所谓开发人体潜能，不如说是让大脑完全掌控肉体，卸下保护层发挥出所有潜在力量。
忽然，白羽又想到一部动漫里的招式。
八门遁甲。
开门，解除脑域限制，以达到发挥出100%的身体能力的目的，超负荷消耗身体能量提升攻、速。
白羽沉吟片刻后点头道：“我应该先研究出一种招式，让身体处于一种燃烧内力换取解除脑域限制的状态，然后百分百发挥出所有力量。”
想到就干，白羽马上又去了一趟藏经阁。
这次，他找来大量有关于这方面的书籍。
这一次，他废寝忘食一连研究了七天。
终于……
院子里，他深吸一口气，然后一掌拍向凉亭柱子上。
没用内力，金钟罩的运行都关了，凭得是纯肉体力量。
还好这里偏僻，动静尽管大，但也没大到引人注意的地步。
挪开手掌，浑圆的柱子没了五分之二，眼瞅着像是要塌。
他赶紧从地上捡了一块石头卡上去，成功卡住。
“还是不要在这里试探为好。”
白羽身形似鬼魅迅速离开这里。
他怕待会儿自己一掌把凉亭打塌，到时候引来皇帝强势围观。
content_en:
There are many unused courtyards in the palace.
Bai Yu found a random room and started carrying martial arts secret books.
Wouldn't it be more comfortable to lie down and watch here?
In the yard, he set up a hammock and lay on it, holding a book of inner strength and mental methods in his hand.
He is currently focusing on mental skills, and plans to research a high-grade internal skill and use it first.
In addition to reading books, he now broadens his meridians every day and continuously accumulates internal energy.
It was too much of a delay. He wanted to develop a magical skill that would automatically widen the meridians and accumulate internal energy throughout the day.
Seeing this sentence, Bai Yu couldn't help but read: "Develop the potential of the human body?"
He sat up and patted his forehead and said: "Hey~, why have you forgotten this? I must study it."
The power hidden in each person's body is originally very huge, but it can't be used at ordinary times, but at critical moments, a weak person with no strength can often hit with a huge force of thousands of kilograms in an instant.
However, the human body will probably be seriously damaged after being used.
The Great Shift of the Universe, isn't that a martial art that activates the potential of the human body?
Zhang Wuji can pretend, but without this skill he cannot pretend to be smooth.
At that moment, Bai Yu made up his mind to research it.
The so-called developing the potential of the human body is better said to be letting the brain completely control the body, taking off the protective layer and unleashing all the potential power.
Suddenly, Bai Yu thought of a move from an anime.
Eight Gates Dunjia.
Open the door and release the limitations of the brain area to achieve the purpose of exerting 100% of the body's ability. Overload consumes the body's energy to increase attack and speed.
"Yeah."
Bai Yu pondered for a moment and then nodded and said: "I should first develop a move that puts the body in a state of burning internal energy in exchange for lifting the limitations of the brain, and then exert all the power 100%."
As soon as he thought of it, Bai Yu immediately went to the Sutra Collection Pavilion again.
This time, he found a large number of books on this aspect.
This time, he studied it for seven days without sleep or food.
Finally...
In the yard, he took a deep breath, then slapped his palm on the pavilion pillar.
"Boom!"
Without the use of internal force, the operation of the golden bell was shut down, relying on pure physical strength.
Fortunately, this place is remote, and although the movement is loud, it is not loud enough to attract attention.
When he removed his palm, two-fifths of the round pillar was gone, and it looked like it was about to collapse.
He quickly picked up a stone from the ground and stuck it on it, and it got stuck successfully.
"It's better not to test it here."
Bai Yu quickly left here like a ghost.
He was afraid that he would knock down the pavilion with one palm later, which would attract the emperor's strong onlookers.
title_en: Chapter 13 The Dog Emperor will be killed within three days Chapter 14 The Great Shift of the Universe
